title: Question chat thinking indicator and navigation redesign
body:
QUESTION CHAT THINKING & PACING
- Added a calm, pulsing thinking indicator and smooth animations while the game evaluates your question.
- Paced response transitions provide natural feedback during deduction.

STREAMLINED NAVIGATION
- Redesigned the top navigation bar, separating links into distinct "Explore" (Leaderboard, Blog, Archive) and "About" (About, FAQ, Contact) dropdowns.
- Removed duplicate navigation links for a cleaner, focused header on desktop and mobile.

ADMIN DASHBOARD REORGANIZATION
- Restructured the admin dashboard into dedicated pillars: Overview, Live Feed, Facts, Questions, and Users.
- Improved live gameplay feed browsing and question auditing diagnostics.
